scope: LOCAL SCALED-DOWN study on an Apple M4 laptop (10 cores, 16 GB). The user chose local compute over a paid GPU instance. Scaling choice: every model is trained on the 100 development days immediately before its validation window (rolling window) instead of the full expanding history; all 200 stocks and complete timestamp cross-sections are kept. Results are labelled 'local-100d' and are not full-data results.

ensembles_nested.note: member configurations, weights and calibration chosen on earlier windows only

final_selection.rule: Among single configurations and equal-weight blends of fixed family-best configurations (all scored on W1..W5 with models trained before each window), pick the lowest mean MAE over W1..W5. A learned-weight or calibrated blend may be chosen only if it beat equal weighting in the nested outer evaluation (W3..W5). The frozen choice is retrained on days 360..459 (gap day 460) and evaluated once on the REUSED terminal holdout 461..480.

feature_audit_wap_vs_mid_price.definition: (wap - mid) / mid * 1e4, mid = (bid + ask) / 2; same-row inputs only (causal)
